description:
Get the questions the carrier needs answered before the user can buy the quote they picked.

Ask the questions in order. Ask a question if all of its visibility_conditions are met, or, when it has none,
if is_visible is true. Check this again after each answer, because an answer can make new questions appear. Of
the questions you'll ask, read back the ones with a current_value together and ask if any have changed; ask the
rest one by one. For a question with child_field_keys, send each part under its child key. If the user doesn't
want to give a driver's license number, or you're not allowed to collect it, send null for it: the licensed
agent will ask for it on the call or in the chat.

Then call zebra_submit_rc2_answers once with the same quote_id and every answer, including the current_values the
user kept. If the user's driver or vehicle details change, call zebra_get_rc1_rates and this tool again: the
questions depend on them.

quote_handle.description: The quote_handle that zebra_start_session returned. It expires 24 hours after zebra_start_session; if a tool reports it unknown or expired, start a new session.

quote_id.description: The quote_id of the quote the user picked, from zebra_get_rc1_rates.

name: zebra_get_rc2_questions

questions.description: The questions to ask the user, in order.

about.description: The driver or vehicle this question is about, or null if it's about the policy.

child_field_keys.description: For a grouped question such as an address or company, the field_key to send each part of the answer under, instead of field_key.

current_value.description: The answer already on file or null if there is none. Make sure to send all values to zebra_submit_rc2_answers even if the current_value is kept.

details.description: More detail on the question (HTML), or null if there is none. Don't read it out unprompted. Tell the user it's available when you ask the question, and if they want it, show all of it as plain text, without summarizing.

disclosure.description: Text the user must see when you ask this question, such as consent to text messages (HTML), or null if there is none. Show all of it as plain text with the question, without summarizing.

field_key.description: Key for this answer in zebra_submit_rc2_answers.

help_text.description: More detail about the question, if the user needs it.

is_visible.description: Whether this question shows before any answers are given. If it has visibility_conditions, those decide whether to ask it once answers come in.

options.description: The allowed answers, sent by value. If empty, any answer is valid. For a CHECKBOX question, send a list of the chosen values, even when only one is chosen: ["Yes"], not "Yes".

items.description: A single option for a select dropdown or radio button

label.description: Displayed to the user to represent this option.

value.description: The value to be returned as the answer when this option is selected.
value.title: Value

prompt.description: The question to ask the user.

required.description: Whether the user must answer this question when it's visible.

suggested_value.description: The Zebra's suggested answer or null. Only set when there's no current_value. Use this value unless a more accurate response is known.

visibility_conditions.description: Ask this question only when ALL of these hold, comparing the answer for each trigger field (its current_value until the user changes it) to the stated value.

items.description: A rule that is dynamically applied to the field to determine if it should be visible or not

comparison.description: Operator for comparing the field's value to the stated value

field.description: Field that should be monitored for changes, and will provide the source value for comparison

value.description: The value to use in the comparison operator
value.title: Value

quote_id.description: The quote_id these questions are for.

title: Get the carrier's follow-up questions
